Greeting at arrival very good, quick to get us to the room. The bar was good and the atmosphere was good. Trying to call the hotel was a ridiculous wait time for a five star, very frustrating as we had to call twice. The brasserie was recommended and we ate there. My wife ordered a green salad to start and they brought a bowl of lettuce only. We requested other salad items and the waitress said it was impossible as they did not have any. She went off and the manager came back with all the items we requested. No big deal but items like this stop you returning. * 3 nights · June 2026 * Couple
